verdict.rationale: llamafile documents support for GGUF LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) and multimodal image description with models like Qwen3.5, Ministral3 and llava1.6, plus speech-to-text through the bundled whisperfile. The evidence names only a handful of architectures, though, far short of the story's "hundreds". missing for 10: evidence of breadth on the order of hundreds of architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-architecture coverage.
